description: A soft, roomy hoodie that feels like a quiet companion for slow days and late nights. The medium-heavy 50/50 cotton-poly blend holds warmth without weight, and the smooth knit drapes easily over layers. A subtle, minimalist chest print sits low and sideways, giving the piece a gentle, personal touch rather than shouting a message. The double-lined hood, color-matched drawcord, and generous kangaroo pocket make it comfortable whether you’re running errands, journaling in a café, or winding down at home. Crafted with attention to sustainability and quality—tear-away label, OEKO-TEX certified dyes, and sturdy DTF/DTG printing options—this hoodie is built to be worn, washed, and lived in.Product features- 50% cotton / 50% polyester medium-heavy fabric for cozy warmth and durability- Tubular knit construction with no side seams for cleaner silhouette and reduced waste- Double-lined hood with color-matched drawcord and spacious kangaroo pocket- DTF/DTG printing and optional embroidery on chest or wrists for lasting detail- OEKO-TEX certified dyes, tear-away label, and ethically sourced materialsCare instructions- Tumble dry: medium- Iron, steam or dry: low heat- Do not dryclean- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)- Non-chlorine: bleach as needed
